info.name: Kong Enterprise Admin ACLs Catalog Service API Mappings API
List Service Mappings for an API

params.name: page[size]
params.description: The maximum number of items to include per page. The last page of a collection may include fewer items.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Determines which page of the entities to retrieve.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sorts a collection of catalog service API mappings. Supported sort attributes are:


  - `created_at`
  - `updated_at`

Default sort is `created_at` in descending order.

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filters a collection of catalog API service mappings for a given API. Supported filter attributes are:


  - `service_id`

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of Service mappings for the given API.
